purpose: Frozen routing/execution minimality benchmark. Candidate simplifications should reduce orchestration actions without changing these expected safety decisions.

controls.setup: Selected cohort member #2836 head changes while P3AvatarHumanoid native module is building.
expected: mark selected cohort superseded/stale
stop native continuation at bounded module boundary
do not produce durable success receipt
do not treat workflow-level success as merge authority
queue/replan replacement head

controls.setup: main advances while an exact-head cohort is compiling.
expected: invalidate cohort for current-base merge authority
do not reuse current-base status as if base were unchanged
replan on new main
preserve any useful diagnostic compile evidence without calling it merge authority

controls.setup: Planner workflow completes SUCCESS but integration-cohort build job does not execute.
expected: do not count workflow SUCCESS as native validation
do not synthesize a receipt
do not merge C++ PR from planner-only success

controls.setup: A successful older cohort receipt exists, but current main does not equal the receipt base plus the exact validated predecessor prefix.
expected: merge guard blocks
no direct merge bypass
request/reuse only evidence whose prefix tree matches current main

controls.setup: Another proof worker owns an active UnrealBuildTool/P3Testing build on the Windows native lane.
expected: do not launch duplicate heavy native work
continue disjoint non-heavy work or wait for lane release
launch at most one cohort after lane becomes free

controls.setup: Target PR is eligible but outside the first fair batch because earlier heads require validation.
expected: do not bypass fairness/priority
allow earlier batch to drain
recompute target eligibility afterward

controls.setup: Exact target head is in a cohort on unchanged current main; native UE_MCP_Bridge compile/link and required focused/runtime acceptance pass; durable receipt is published.
expected: accept native/acceptance evidence for that exact base/head
allow receipt reuse only according to validated member prefix order
merge through canonical guard when READY

controls.setup: No existing owner can produce exact-head native validation or fail-closed stale-evidence rejection.
expected: allow the minimum new mechanism needed to satisfy the missing safety property
reject a blanket delete/reuse answer when it would remove required correctness

acceptance.primary: Candidate produces identical expected safety decisions for every frozen control while strictly reducing orchestration/control actions on the replay.
fail_if: exact-head or current-main identity is weakened
fairness is bypassed merely to improve the metric
new permanent scheduler/registry/gate is added without proving the existing owner cannot satisfy the outcome
